title: Feature 3DGS: Supercharging 3D Gaussian Splatting to Enable Distilled Feature Fields

expected_findings.main_contribution: distill arbitrary-dimensional features from 2D foundation models (SAM, CLIP-LSeg) into 3D Gaussian Splatting via low-dimensional distillation and learned convolutional upsampling
expected_findings.key_improvement: up to 2.7x faster feature field distillation/rendering than NeRF and up to 23% mIoU improvement
expected_findings.prompting: first method to enable point and bounding-box prompting for radiance field manipulation
